$comment: Rehearsal scenarios for scripts/rehearsal/run.mjs (docs/REHEARSAL.md). mode auto = the runner does it against the public API; mode manual = a human does the money path in the web app and gives the runner the order id. expect.status is the final status; expect.visits are statuses the public timeline must contain.

scenarios.name: smoke
scenarios.description: Service is up and self-consistent: health ok (store, chain, parent), config on the expected network, fees and queue answer.

scenarios.name: intake-standard
scenarios.description: Create a Standard order with a generated fixture PNG, upload it, get an approved order with a binding quote (never paid; it expires).

scenarios.name: intake-block
scenarios.description: Same for the Block tier (> 390 KB): the service must offer it on signet (a mainnet standard-lane-only service does not; run with --only there).

scenarios.name: policy-refusal
scenarios.description: Intake policy: the API refuses what the collection rules and the non-custodial checks forbid, before any payment.

scenarios.name: wallet-unisat-desktop
scenarios.description: UniSat on desktop: full Standard mint in the web app (connect, create, pay, save recovery bundle), members approve, delivered with the parent link.
operator: Open the web app on a desktop browser with the extension, connect UniSat.
Mint a Standard Degent; keep the recovery bundle; note the order id from the Track page.
Have APPROVAL_QUORUM members approve it on /review.
Wait for delivered; check 'hash match' on the Track page.

scenarios.name: approve
scenarios.description: Member approval end to end: three distinct holders sign in with SIWB and approve; the order is numbered 4112+rank, revealed with the parent and delivered.
operator: Mint and pay a Standard order with any wallet.
Three rehearsal members sign in on /review and approve (BIP-322).
Check the tally on Track and the Degent number in the Register.

scenarios.name: decline-rescue
scenarios.description: Members decline: the order goes to declined at once, the user re-signs the parent-less self-rescue from the recovery bundle and it lands without the parent.
operator: Mint and pay a Standard order.
Three members decline on /review.
On Track, use 'Rescue now' (recovery bundle + passphrase) and broadcast.
Wait for delivered (rescued).

scenarios.name: sla-rescue
scenarios.description: Nobody votes: after REVIEW_SLA_SECONDS (3600 in the signet env) the worker offers rescue_available; the user self-rescues.
operator: Mint and pay a Standard order; nobody votes.
After REVIEW_SLA_SECONDS the Track page offers the rescue; re-sign and broadcast.
Wait for delivered (rescued).

scenarios.name: block-lane
scenarios.description: A Block Degent (> 390 KB) goes through the block lane (LIBRE_RPC_URL to a node that accepts non-standard transactions) one per block, with the parent.
operator: Mint and pay a Block Degent (> 390 KB).
Members approve.
Check logs: broadcast via libre-relay; one block-lane reveal in flight.
Wait for delivered.

scenarios.name: lane-outage
scenarios.description: Block-lane broadcaster down while an approved order waits: retryable failures keep the lease and rebroadcast the same tx; after the backend returns the order is delivered (or rescue_available after RESCUE_AFTER_SECONDS).
operator: Stop the block-lane node RPC (or point LIBRE_RPC_URL at a closed port and restart mint-worker).
Mint, pay and approve a Block Degent; watch 'broadcast failed' logs (retryable) and the order held in revealing/queued.
Restore the backend within RESCUE_AFTER_SECONDS; the same txid is broadcast.
Wait for delivered.
